name: pin-it
description: A local pinboard for saving anything you want to reuse with any AI.
author: Johnny Z

scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build:native && concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173 --strictPort" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:mcp && npm run build:native
scripts.dist:mac:prod: npm run build:icon:mac && npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --x64
scripts.dist:mac:dev: npm run build:icon:mac && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.dev.cjs --mac dmg zip --arm64
scripts.pack:mac:prod: npm run build:icon:mac && npm run build && electron-builder --mac dir --arm64 --x64
scripts.pack:mac:dev: npm run build:icon:mac && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.dev.cjs --mac dir --arm64
scripts.release: npm run build:icon:mac && npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --x64 --publish always
scripts.check: npm run audit:prod && npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.test: npm run test:node && npm run test:ui && npm run test:mcp
scripts.test:mcp:packaged:prod: npm run test:mcp:packaged:prod:arm64 && npm run test:mcp:packaged:prod:x64
scripts.test:mcp:channels: npm run test:mcp:packaged:dev && npm run test:mcp:installed:prod
scripts.test:node: node tests/packet.test.js && node tests/store.test.js && node tests/update.test.cjs && node tests/credentialStore.test.cjs && node tests/openaiHarness.test.cjs && node tests/mcpConfig.test.cjs && node tests/appChannel.test.cjs && node tests/onboardingWindow.test.cjs && node tests/onboardingState.test.cjs && node tests/screenshotCapture.test.cjs && node tests/screenCapturePermission.test.cjs && node tests/siteReleaseDownloads.test.js && node tests/macReleaseManifest.test.cjs && node tests/releaseVersion.test.cjs
